> **Historical.** The Gatsby-parity shell described here was replaced by the arcade design (DESIGN.md) and the modules it names
> (`build_via_papyrus.py`, `anthus_pages.py`, `anthus_mdx.py`, `site_env.py`) are gone; the site now runs on Papyrus's standard
> front end with hooks (README.md, AGENTS.md).

# Design parity with the production Anth.us site

Goal: the port's front end looks exactly like production Anth.us, proven by
screenshots. This replaces the earlier WIP handoff; the build now runs end to
end.

## How the pieces fit

* **Stylesheet.** `web/css/anthus-theme.css` is generated by
  `bin/build-theme-css.py` from the real Anth.us SCSS/CSS Modules (class-name
  hashes in `web/css/css-module-hashes.json`). Papyrus copies it to
  `dist/css/site-theme.css`, which is what pages link.
* **Shell (no monkeypatching).** `SiteChrome` hooks in `build_via_papyrus.py`:
  `render_masthead` (production `header`), `render_body` (`#___gatsby` /
  `.layout` / `.wrapper>main` / footer / priority-plus scripts), `head_html`
  (favicon + Google Fonts), `title_template="{title} | Anthus"`,
  `asset_root="/"`. `body_class=""` renders `<body class="">`; `finish_pages`
  removes the empty attribute so `<body>` matches production.
* **Content bodies** (articles, platform products) go through Markus with
  `ANTHUS_TRANSFORM` (`strip_header`, block passthrough, `class_map`, drop
  `markus-`/`papyrus-`). Crossing `--allow-html`-less Markus uses Papyrus
  sentinels: `<mark>` -> `inline_sentinel("mark", ...)`; the production
  `.heading` block, inline `<svg>`, colspan tables and JSX `blockDiagram`
  trees -> `block_sentinel(...)`.
* **Images.** `ImagePipeline(wrap=anthus_dom.anthus_image_wrap)` re-emits
  Papyrus renditions inside gatsby-plugin-image's constrained DOM (sizer div
  with a `height`/`width` SVG; the CSS positions the real `<img>` absolutely).
  Authored wrappers (`div`/`figure.center-full-image`, `div.center-small-image`,
  floated `div`) are encoded as `layout="<layout>@<key>"` by
  `anthus_mdx._convert_image_wrappers` because `::image{}` has no wrapper
  attribute. `figcaption` becomes `caption=` and is re-emitted as
  `<figcaption class="image-caption"><p>`. `<p class="center-full-image">` is
  not reproduced: production nests a block `<div>` in it, so the parser closes
  the `<p>` before the `<div>` and the class never applies.
* **Generated pages** (home, articles index, posts, tags, platform index,
  about, ai-solutions, ryan, 404, engage, reading, research, decision-models)
  bypass Markus: HTML from `anthus_pages` / `anthus_page_html` rendered by
  `markus_shell.render_page`. `anthus_page_html.py` is generated by
  `bin/extract-page-html.py`; do not hand-edit it.
* **Post-pass** `finish_pages` (before `relocate_pages`): link canonicalization,
  social meta, `noindex` guard, and the `markus-`/`papyrus-` class gate on
  every written page.

## Findings worth keeping

* Production `/platform/<product>/` renders with **no chrome** in the
  2026-09-24 reference build (a production bug). `platform_product_head/tail`
  implement what `platform-product.jsx` intends; there is no visual reference.
* React artefacts reproduced deliberately: `class="... undefined"`, trailing
  space in unfeatured solution items, `<div class="blog-post-preview">` around
  an `<li>`, nested `<p>` from `dangerouslySetInnerHTML` excerpts.
* The hand-authored JSX diagrams (`blockDiagram`, request/response
  transcripts, one `.map()` bar chart) and `{/* */}` JSX comments in the
  content were previously turned into code blocks / visible text; they are now
  converted (`anthus_mdx._convert_jsx_diagrams`).
* The production bundle never defines `--color-background-secondary`,
  `--color-text-light`, `--line-height-loose`; rules using them are inert there
  too. Do not "fix" that.

## Verification (2026-10-03, against the live reference)

Reference: `/Users/home/Projects/Anth.us-live/public/` (a build of the deployed
commit, stylesheet byte-identical to live), served on 8081; tag pages and
`/posts/page/4/` against `/Users/home/Projects/Anth.us-live-mirror/html/`
(listing order differs between builds). Harness: `bin/shoot.cjs` +
`bin/compare.py`. The new build is the submodule pin (ab15f2b); production
builds content 4b80f02. To separate content drift from design drift I built
4b80f02 into a scratch tree (`ANTHUS_CONTENT_DIR`, `ANTHUS_BUILD_DIR`) and
re-measured the 101 articles that exist on both: every height delta was
identical under both content versions, so none of the remaining differences are
content-driven.

Expected on every page: the footer staging note (+48px at 1440, +57px at 390)
and encoding noise on photos.

### Whole-corpus article sweep (1440)

`/tmp` script `heights3.js` loaded all 101 articles on both sites (lazy images
forced) and compared `scrollHeight`. Residual delta after removing the staging
note and the bibliography height difference:

* 98 within 6px.
* `notebooklm` -77: live bug (below).
* `langchain-by-example` -51: one table cell holds Markdown with entity-escaped
  code fences and inline `- ` bullets after `<br/>`; MDX renders it as two
  paragraphs, this build as one. Not fixed (one article).
* `inspected-by-pudicus` +25: a paragraph that is only `<mark>...</mark>` renders
  on live as a bare top-level `<mark>` with no paragraph margin; here it is a `<p>`.

### Differences that are not design bugs

* **Bibliographies.** Live's static HTML has an empty `<ol class="citationslist">`
  that `gatsby-citation-manager` fills after hydration, in its own style (title
  first). Papyrus renders APA from the CSL data at build time. Entries therefore
  differ in text and sometimes in wrapped height.
* **notebooklm.** `blog-image.jsx` finds an image with
  `relativePath.endsWith(name)`; `Google-NotebookLM.png` ends with
  `NotebookLM.png` and sorts first, so live shows the wrong image on
  `/blog/notebooklm/`. This build shows the one the author named. Any other
  image whose name is a suffix of another file's is exposed to the same bug on
  live; none was found in the height sweep.
* **Dates on /ai-solutions/ integrations.** `new Date("2018-04-30")` is UTC
  midnight; after hydration a browser west of UTC shows "April 29". The static
  HTML (and this build) say April 30.
* **Same-date ordering** in listings (above), and live tag pages are unsorted.
* **Platform product pages** have no usable reference (production renders them
  without chrome).
* Footer staging note and the new URL shapes (`/articles/<slug>/`,
  `/tags/<tag>/`, `/posts/page/N/`).

### How the static DOM matches live's post-hydration DOM

Production serves HTML that React then rebuilds in the browser; several
constructs only have their final heights after hydration:

* `<p style><p>text</p></p>` from MDX (an explicit `<p>` whose text MDX wraps
  again): emitted as a `<div>` with the same inline style around the inner `<p>`
  (a parser cannot nest `<p>`). `<p class="center-full-image">` around an image
  likewise becomes a `<div>` carrying the `<p>` bottom margin.
* Excerpts holding block elements (`dangerouslySetInnerHTML` into a `<p>`):
  emitted in a `<div>`; it keeps the `p` margin only where live has it.
* MDX Markdown inside JSX flow (text lines in a diagram `<div>`, `1.` lists):
  wrapped in `<p>`/`<ol>` as MDX does (`anthus_mdx._mdx_flow_paragraphs`).

### Re-running

```bash
python3 -m http.server 8081 --directory /Users/home/Projects/Anth.us-live/public &
python3 bin/dev-server.py --port 8082 &
node bin/shoot.cjs --base http://localhost:8081 --out /tmp/shots/old --pages old.json --widths 1440,390
node bin/shoot.cjs --base http://localhost:8082 --out /tmp/shots/new --pages new.json --widths 1440,390
python3 bin/compare.py /tmp/shots/old /tmp/shots/new --diff-out /tmp/shots/diff
python3 bin/simulate-redirects.py --sitemap sitemap-0.xml
```
